**App or feature**

Which app, and which feature of it.

**The question**

One specific question the entry would answer. Narrow beats broad: "what happens when the page loads before you log in?" works, "how does the app work?" does not.

**Why people would care**

Who uses this and why they wonder about it.

**Anything you have already observed (optional)**

Public, unauthenticated observations only. No accounts, no private data.
